description.zh:
数据来源，取值如下：

- `agent`：新版服务查询需要传递。
- `registry`：旧版服务查询传递。
description.en:
The source of the data. Valid values:

*   `agent`: Use this value if you use the service query feature of the latest version to pass the query result.
*   `registry`: Use this value if you use the service query feature of the earlier version to pass the query result.
The number of the page to return. Pages start from Page 0.

description.zh:
服务类型，取值如下：

- `app`：应用维度查询。
- `service`：服务维度查询。
- `providerIp`：IP维度查询。
description.en:
The type of the service. Valid values:

*   `app`: searches by application.
*   `service`: searches by service.
*   `providerIp`: searches by IP address.

description.zh:
搜索关键字：

- 如果searchType=app，searchValue填写`appId`。
- 如果serachType=service，searchValue填写`serviceName`。
- 如果searchType=providerIp，searchValue填写应用IP地址。
description.en:
The keyword used for the search.

*   Set this parameter to the ID of the application if you set the searchType parameter to app.``
*   Set this parameter to the name of the service if you set the serachType parameter to service.``
*   Set this parameter to the IP address of the application if you set the searchType parameter to providerIp.

The type of the service. Valid values:

*   `dubbo`
*   `springCloud`
*   `hsf`
*   `istio`

description.zh:
提供者侧或者消费者侧，取值如下：

- provider
- consumer
description.en:
Specifies the provider side or the consumer side. Valid values:

*   provider
*   consumer

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas get-service-list-page --biz-region cn-hangzhou --namespace cn-hangzhou:doc-test --origin Agent --service-type SpringCloud --search-type App --search-value com.alibaba.edas.HelloService --side provider --page 0 --size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun edas POST /pop/sp/api/mseForOam/getServiceListPage --region cn-hangzhou --serviceType SpringCloud --side provider --size 10 --searchType App --origin Agent --namespace 'cn-hangzhou:doc-test' --page 0 --region 'cn-hangzhou' --searchValue 'com.alibaba.edas.HelloService' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
